blogs.title: Tourist Places Near by Sulthan Bathery
blogs.excerpt: Discover the prehistoric rock engravings of Edakkal Caves, the 14th-century Jain Temple, and the elephant herds of Muthanga Wildlife Sanctuary.
blogs.content: Sulthan Bathery is the historic heart of Wayanad, named after Tipu Sultan who used the ancient Jain Temple as his battery (ammunition storehouse). Located at an elevation of 930 meters, it is bordered by the wildlife-rich forests of Muthanga. Visiting the Neolithic petroglyphs at Edakkal Caves just 10km away reveals engravings dating back to 6,000 BCE.
blogs.author: Aston Holidays

blogs.title: Tourist Places Near by Mananthavady
blogs.excerpt: From the dense evergreen archipelago of Kuruva Island to the sacred waters of Papanasini at Thirunelli Temple and Pazhassi Raja's tomb.
blogs.content: Mananthavady sits on the banks of the Kabini River and serves as the cultural gateway to Northern Wayanad. The 950-acre Kuruva Island with its bamboo rafts, rare orchids, and serene waterways is an absolute must-visit. Higher up into the Brahmagiri foothills lies Thirunelli Maha Vishnu Temple, revered for millennia as the 'Kashi of the South'.
blogs.author: Aston Holidays

blogs.title: Tourist Places Near by Kalpetta
blogs.excerpt: Explore the bustling headquarters of Wayanad surrounded by verdant coffee hills, Karapuzha Dam, and the ancient Koottamundu Glass Temple.
blogs.content: Kalpetta is the administrative and commercial epicenter of Wayanad. Located conveniently in the center of the district, it gives you quick access to Karapuzha earthen dam, sprawling spice markets, and aromatic coffee processing estates. The Glass Temple dedicated to the Jain Tirthankara Parshvanatha on the slopes of Vellarimala is a hidden architectural marvel.
blogs.author: Aston Holidays

blogs.title: Best 5 Cafes in Mananthavady
blogs.excerpt: Looking for freshly brewed artisan Wayanadan coffee, wood-fired snacks, and cozy rain-view seats in Mananthavady? Here are the top 5 spots.
blogs.content: Mananthavady's cafe culture has blossomed with vibrant spots catering to travelers heading towards Kuruva and Thirunelli. Experience single-origin Robusta roasts, layered Malabar snacks, iced cardamom espressos, and scenic plantation verandas.
blogs.author: Aston Holidays

blogs.title: Best 5 Cafes in Kalpetta
blogs.excerpt: Where to find the best specialty brews, artisanal Malabar tea blends, and delicious pastries after a long day of Wayanad sightseeing.
blogs.content: Kalpetta boasts some of the most charming cafes in the Western Ghats. From roasteries serving fresh estate harvests to cozy mountain lounges with high-speed WiFi, explore the 5 best cafe haunts in Kalpetta town.
blogs.author: Aston Holidays
